subject: SummitLink APAC co-sell: finalizing host & run-of-show
messages:
From: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@summitlink.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@summitlink.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T05:15:00Z
Subject: SummitLink APAC co-sell — initial ops + proposed slots

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. SummitLink is excited to run an APAC-focused co-sell demo with Redwood for a joint retail prospect next week. We need to lock a host from the AWS SI side and coordinate a short technical preflight (20m) the morning of the demo.

Proposed demo windows (SG / SGT):
- Tue 2027-10-05, 09:00–09:45 (SGT)
- Tue 2027-10-05, 14:00–14:45 (SGT)
- Wed 2027-10-06, 11:00–11:45 (SGT)

Can you confirm which slot works for Redwood and whether you can host the run-of-show? We will bring the SummitLink SI lead (Amit) and an AWS SI ops point — who I’ve looped in.

Two asks up front:
1) Can Redwood share a short run-of-show PDF and tech checklist we can use for our rehearsal?
2) Any restrictions on recording or regional data routing we should be aware of?

Thanks — Sophia

—
Sophia Chen
Partner Programs, SummitLink
Sophia.chen@summitlink.com
+65 9123 4567

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@summitlink.com>
Cc: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@summitlink.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T07:04:00Z
Subject: Re: SummitLink APAC co-sell — initial ops + proposed slots

Hi Sophia — great to meet you.

All three slots could work for us but we prefer Tue 2027-10-05, 14:00 SGT to give the SI and our PM time for a rehearsal earlier that day. I’ve looped Kimberly (partner ops) and Vanessa (technical PM) — they’ll coordinate the preflight.

Quick answers:
- I'll host the demo and can provide a run-of-show and tech checklist (attached: RL-RunOfShow-v1.pdf, SummitLink-Tech-Checklist.xlsx).
- Recording is fine; default retention is 30 days. If the prospect requires different retention, let us know and we’ll route to our compliance team.

Can Amit/AWS Ops confirm availability for a 20m preflight on Tue 2027-10-05 at 12:30 SGT? If that works we’ll send calendar invites and a shared Drive link for assets.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@summitlink.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@summitlink.com>
Cc: AWS SI Ops <aws-si-ops@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T03:18:00Z
Subject: Re: SummitLink APAC co-sell — initial ops + proposed slots

Karthik, Sophia — thanks for the details. I’m available to be the SummitLink technical lead, but AWS SI Ops flagged a host conflict: their primary engineer is booked at 14:00 SGT on 2027-10-05.

Two options from our side:
A) Move the demo to Tue 2027-10-05 at 09:00 SGT (AWS ops is free then).
B) Keep 14:00 SGT and AWS provides a backup host (junior engineer) — we prefer a rehearsal if B.

If Redwood needs the senior AWS host specifically, option A is the safe bet. If you keep the 14:00 slot we’re happy to proceed with a short rehearsal at 12:30 SGT to align handoffs.

Amit
SummitLink — Technical Lead

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@summitlink.com>, Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@summitlink.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:50:00Z
Subject: Re: SummitLink APAC co-sell — initial ops + proposed slots

Thanks for the heads up, Amit. Appreciate the flexibility.

Decision for speed: let’s take option B — keep Tue 2027-10-05, 14:00 SGT as the demo slot and schedule a mandatory 20m technical preflight at 12:30 SGT where AWS will either confirm the senior host or confirm the backup host and run through the handoff. Vanessa — can you run the preflight checklist and own the host handoff process?

Kimberly — I’ll need you to issue a calendar invite with the following:
- Event: SummitLink × Redwood co-sell demo (APAC)
- Demo: Tue 2027-10-05, 14:00–14:45 SGT
- Preflight: Tue 2027-10-05, 12:30–12:50 SGT (mandatory)
- Links: Drive run-of-show, recording enabled, slack channel #partners-summitlink

Soojin — tagging you to confirm that recording retention (30 days) is acceptable for the prospect. If the prospect has special retention requirements we’ll need legal sign-off by EOD Mon 2027-10-04.

I’ll send a short internal runbook to the group shortly.

Karthik

From: Sophia Chen <sophia.chen@summitlink.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Joshi <amit.joshi@summitlink.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, AWS SI Ops <aws-si-ops@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T14:09:00Z
Subject: Re: SummitLink APAC co-sell — finalizing host & run-of-show

Perfect — invites received and accepted from our side.

Two quick confirmations:
1) We ran through RL-RunOfShow-v1 and made one edit to timing — shared a comment in Drive.
2) Recording retention of 30 days is acceptable to the prospect. No special legal sign-off needed.

Looking forward to the preflight at 12:30 SGT. See you all then.

—
Sophia
Partner Programs, SummitLink
